# IRSProb

> > Texas-based CPA firm specializing in comprehensive IRS tax relief, debt resolution, and audit defense services.

IRSProb provides expert assistance with federal tax problems including liens, levies, audits, and debt settlement negotiations. Founded by CPA Randell Martin, the firm serves individuals and businesses across Texas with specialized tax resolution programs and representation before the IRS.

## Key Topics

- Offer in Compromise (OIC)
- Federal Tax Liens & Levies
- IRS Audits
- Installment Agreements
- Innocent Spouse Relief
- Trust Fund Recovery Penalties
- IRS Representation
- Tax Debt Resolution
- CPA & Enrolled Agent Services
- Wage Garnishment Defense
- Form 9465 & Form 8857
- Austin & Texas Tax Relief
- Back Taxes Settlement
- Audit Preparation & Defense
- Tax Negotiation & Settlement

## Core Tax Relief Services

- [Offer In Compromise](https://irsprob.com/offer-in-compromise): Expert offer in compromise solutions to negotiate and reduce tax debt settlement.
- [Federal IRS Tax Liens And Levies](https://irsprob.com/federal-irs-tax-liens-and-levies): Expert solutions for federal IRS tax liens, levies, asset seizure and wage garnishment.
- [IRS Installment Agreements](https://irsprob.com/installment-agreements): IRS-approved installment agreements and payment plans using Form 9465.
- [IRS Audits](https://irsprob.com/irs-audits): Professional IRS audit defense and representation for audit preparation and resolution.
- [Innocent Spouse Relief](https://irsprob.com/innocent-spouse-relief): Specialized innocent spouse relief assistance using Form 8857 and IRC 6015 guidance.
- [Trust Fund Recovery Penalties](https://irsprob.com/trust-fund-recovery-penalties): TFRP and payroll tax liability resolution with responsible person defense strategies.

## Geographic Services

- [Federal Tax Liens In Austin TX](https://irsprob.com/austin/federal-tax-liens): Austin-specific federal tax lien resolution, withdrawal and discharge strategies.
- [Tax Relief Services - Texas](https://irsprob.com/federal-irs-tax): Texas tax relief services covering OIC, installment agreements and IRS representation.
